notes.title: Free Weekend and Holiday update Release!
notes.notes:
Welcome, Specters and Travelers!! December 9th , 2021 - Our December holiday update comes with a  bunch of new features and jobs waiting for you to explore. The Free Weekend starts From 12/9/2021 10:00 am to 12/13 10:00 am(PST), players in the world can easily download and play Fear Surrounds on Steam for free this weekend. We also offer the biggest discount since we released the game, you will get 70% off discount during the weekend!. So don’t wait and join us now!  

Update Time: December 9,2021, 5:00PM PST
Update Content: New Function and New Career
Downtime: 2h

Details：
1.	Decoration Update
New Hospital now hang up with some new decoration by unknown existence.
2. New Tutorial
Supply with Specific New Tutorial Scene, provide the basics of the Game, after you finish the tutorial you will fully understand how to play the game in no time.

3. Lobby Tag Team Report
Now players can report bad behavior in the lobby, you may report the same team bad behavior players, please be caution of using report function

4. Third party Wining Rate
Now we have add the third party winning Rate, (Totally: Travelers Winning Rate/Spectre Wining Rate / Third Party Winning Rate

High Priest can make a soul-connection between two players. If one player is a traveler and the other one is a specter, then both players are turning to the third party. Their only goal is to kill both the other Specters and travelers.

notes.title: Full Release with Discount !
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that 3D horror werewolf killing game 'Fear Surrounds' fully launches on Oct 20th!

We remake the classic 'Hospital' map and launch a new map 'Villa'. We have greatly improved the UI, released five new professions, and provided new features such as Game Pass and reputation score.

The game is currently on sale with a 30% off discount, the same price as Early Access phase, but with more content!

'Fear Surrounds' was released in Feb this year by a two-person development team named SaltyEgg Studio.  The game is Very Positive on Steam during the EA phase and ranks the second top seller under the Social Deduction tag, right after Among Us. Thanks for your support!

Introduction to version update:

1. Hospital map remake
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39764445/da472f290342c3e2caafbb49b61bc98d8fe4961d.png[/img]

2. New map: Villa
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39764445/88482b0a4c1b9640f8b481cf47e8bdc89532bc29.png[/img]

Though it's geographically inconvenient, the villa is located in the mountains with river running down in a traquil environment. The villa is elegantly furnished and was admired by many people.The auction price goes to a record high.

More than 10 years ago, the owner of the villa died mysteriously, followed by all sorts of rumors, which further cast a dark shadown to this villa. Some people say that the villa owner held a cult ceremony in the villa and was reflected into evil spirits; Some people say that the villa was built by the cult, which hides all kinds of evil spirits; Others say that the villa itself is the entrance to hell.

The villa owner's identity becomes very mysterious, and they believe it has some connection with the cult. Once the rumors crazily spread out, no one dare to take over the villa.

3. Character Remake

4. New features

-Game Pass: premium skins and hairstyles.

-Reputation score: optimize the game environment.

-Mission add guidance feature: easy for new players to get started.

-Language matching: Let players speak the same language play together, in case they cannot communicate in other languages.

-Optimization: Add silent mode to allow players who don't have a mic or don't want to open one to play the game.


5. New occupation

-Pope: Has the ability to read ordinary people's mind knowing who they are and letting others know who they are. The Pope, on the other hand, is a symbol of light, and once the light is out, evil spirits are free.

-Guard: has the ability to protect others from a single evil spirit, but unfortunately, he cannot protect himself.

-Resentful Spirit: has the ability to manipulate corpses, can let the dead follow his action, thus forging the first crime scene.

-Hundred Faces: can pretend to be someone else, making it impossible to tell the difference between real and fake so that he/she can move freely. But his/her powers are dispelled the moment he enters the church.

-Wraith: can disappear frequently, creating alibis and time gaps, but he/she has to be careful not to let anyone alive see he/she disappear or appear at that moment.


6. Add a variety of hairstyles, headshots and costumes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39764445/1afea52b369df591f2489cdc159db1c0b3fd4de6.png[/img]

7. Add kill animation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39764445/faba4fc0b8c5438b07941c9105826d5f8bd5d28a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39764445/26583544331e5e415f205c26498af1963a21944d.png[/img]
